slides.title: Adding Users
slides.html:
• Admin tools can be easily accessed from the sidebar
  • Select "Add Users"

slides.title: Invite Codes
slides.html: • Either select a current invite code or create a new one.

slides.title: Using the invite codes
slides.html:
• Users can scan the QR code from your device.
  • You can also share a link or create a easily printable PDF for example.
  • Users will be now able to reach the waiting room.

slides.title: Approve Users
slides.html:
• You should now have users in the waiting room.
  • You can reach it from the sidebar

slides.title: Approving Users
slides.html:
You have a few options on approving users:

  • Scan QR Code shown on their devices (recommended).
  • Click on a user and enter code shown on their device.
  • Open a link shared by a user to you. When accepting users (especially with links) be 100% sure the person is who you think they are. Accepting them gives access to for example troop locations if using TAK.

slides.title: Closing an invite code
slides.html:
• For increased security it is wise to either close or disable invite codes when they are not required.
  • Code management is opened by pressing the button next to the code.
